cases.name: Janet Ann Couture
cases.about: Janet had recently moved to East Hartford from her family's home in New Hampshire and she worked at Stanadyne Inc., an industrial parts firm in Windsor, CT.
cases.narrative: On 10/13/1973, her neighbor found her nude body in her bedroom, a "large-bladed kitchen knife" was found at the scene.

cases.name: Shamaia L. Smith
cases.about: She was an exotic dancer at the Kahoot's Gentlemen's Club.
cases.narrative: In 4/2007, investigators found gun shell casings and her charred remains included teeth, her left foot and bone fragments from her legs, arms, back, pelvis and skull in a fire pit on a 75-acre wooded tract he owned on Route 190, also known as Chestnut Hill Road, in Stafford.

cases.name: Upma Sharma
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She was born and raised in Punjab, India. Upma dedicated her life to being a wonderful mother and wife. As a homemaker, she found joy in cooking, gardening, and helping to raise her grandchildren. She loved traveling and cherished the time spent surrounded by family and friends. Religion was central to Upma's life, as she was a firm believer in God. She will be remembered for her wisdom and caring nature."
